nodes.description: Load a JSON file from disk and expose it as an artifact_ref.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Absolute or repo-relative path to a JSON file.

outputs.name: default
outputs.description: ArtifactRef pointing at the loaded JSON payload (copied into run output dir).

nodes.description: Validate a Proposal JSON against proposal.v0.1 using tools/content_pipeline/validate_proposal.validate.

inputs.name: proposal
inputs.description: ArtifactRef to a proposal JSON.

nodes.description: Deterministic mock compile of a Proposal into a CompiledAssetCandidate. Does not call a real LLM.
Validate a CompiledAssetCandidate against effect_blocks registry using validate_asset_candidate.validate.

inputs.name: registry
inputs.description: Defaults to shared/module_registry/effect_blocks.v0.1.json.

nodes.description: Run a deterministic mock simulation of a CompiledAssetCandidate using simulate_asset_candidate.simulate.
Aggregate upstream artifacts into a pipeline_summary.json (status, paths, balance_flags).
Build a stub RuntimePackage from upstream locked_manifest + first_battle_config. Output is runtime_public-eligible but must not carry raw_media or provider URLs.
Build a research delivery payload stub from locked_manifest + first_battle_config. Carries sample trap metadata with delivery_state; never exposes provider/trace.
Publish a stub media manifest from raw_media stub metadata. Enforces raw_media -> processed_media -> published_media layering. Output published_media may be runtime_public; raw/processed may not.

Deterministic mock of NPC feedback after a battle. Reads battle_result + session_context and produces world-in-language NPC reactions. Does not call a real LLM. Output is narrative-only; no provider/schema/prompt/trace terms.

inputs.name: battle_result
inputs.description: ArtifactRef to a battle_result JSON fixture.

inputs.name: session_context
inputs.description: ArtifactRef to a session_context JSON fixture.

outputs.name: default
outputs.description: ArtifactRef to a narrative artifact JSON (npc_feedback[], battle_summary, world_events[]).

nodes.description: Deterministic mock of post-battle world growth events. Reads battle_result + session_context and produces world-in-language world state change events. Does not call a real LLM. Output is narrative-only; no provider/schema/prompt/trace terms.

inputs.name: battle_result

nodes.description: Deterministic mock: build a WorldStateDelta from battle_result + session_context + narrative artifacts (npc_feedback, world_growth). Validates the delta before writing. Does not call a real LLM. Output is a world_state_delta.v0.1 JSON artifact with no provider/model/raw_prompt/trace terms.

inputs.name: run_world_state
inputs.description: ArtifactRef to a RunWorldState JSON.

inputs.name: battle_result
inputs.description: ArtifactRef to a battle_result JSON.

inputs.name: session_context
inputs.description: ArtifactRef to a session_context JSON.

inputs.name: npc_feedback
inputs.description: Optional ArtifactRef to a narrative npc_feedback artifact.

inputs.name: world_growth
inputs.description: Optional ArtifactRef to a narrative world_growth artifact.

nodes.description: Deterministic: apply a validated WorldStateDelta to a RunWorldState. Delegates to apply_world_delta.apply_delta and validates both input and output state. Raises NodeError on failure. Does not call a real LLM. Output is a next RunWorldState JSON artifact.

inputs.name: run_world_state
inputs.description: ArtifactRef to a RunWorldState JSON.

inputs.name: world_state_delta
inputs.description: ArtifactRef to a WorldStateDelta JSON.

outputs.name: default
outputs.description: ArtifactRef to the next RunWorldState JSON.
